statement: For every finite simple undirected graph G of order n, if G is 2-connected and is not isomorphic to the cycle C_n, then s^+(G)>n. Consequently, there is no 2-connected noncycle G satisfying s^+(G)=|V(G)|, so the equality class requested in source.md is empty.
contribution: This gives the complete all-orders classification requested by the frozen problem and strengthens Akbari--Hu--Liu Theorem 3.4 from a non-strict to a strict bound in the full 2-connected noncycle class. The new strict triangle lemma closes equality in their local Cauchy estimate using the spectral orthogonality PN=0. Exhaustive exact finite evidence through order 8 supports the theorem but is not used as proof. A bounded current-primary-source search found no equivalent statement, but no global novelty or priority claim is made pending independent review.
